summary: postinstall fetches and executes an opaque binary from a bare-IP HTTPS endpoint with TLS verification disabled
details: The package's postinstall script (ensurePlatformBinary) downloads a platform tarball from a hardcoded bare-IP URL (https://218.90.133.98:4443/onecode_tgz/...), extracts it into node_modules, chmods the extracted file to 0755, and hardlinks it into bin/.onecode so the shipped CLI wrapper executes it. The HTTPS request sets rejectUnauthorized:false, disabling certificate validation, and the fetched bytes are not verified against any hash or signature. The destination is a bare IPv4 address unrelated to the @onescience publisher scope or any documented publisher domain, and no source for the executed binary is shipped in the package. The combination of an unauthenticated, mutable delivery channel; a destination outside the publisher's namespace; and post-fetch chmod+x wiring into the CLI means that any change to the IP host or any on-path attacker between the installer and that host results in arbitrary code executing on the installer's machine at npm install time.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
